inputs.text: [excited] ed… mon… TOH… nee… uh. This name doesn't come from Greek — [pauses] it comes from a place.
[happily] Yep, it was found near the city of Edmonton, in Canada. [amazed] So they called it "the one from Edmonton." [calm] It lived seventy-two million years ago, covered head to tail in armor.
[confident] A cousin, yes. [curious] But with one big difference, you'll see.
